Phase 4: diagrams

Diagrams

In plain words
Pictures of the planned system: who uses it, what runs where, how statuses change, how a booking flows step by step, and how the tables link.
Each picture has a short caption and a legend explaining its symbols.
The .mmd files are the editable sources (Mermaid text). The rendered/ folder holds SVG (sharp at any zoom) and PNG versions.
The table diagrams (erd-*) are generated from ../schema.dbml, so they always match the schema.

How to re-render: python ../_tools/build_schema_docs.py (ERD sources), then python ../_tools/render_diagrams.py (needs @mermaid-js/mermaid-cli installed in a tools folder outside the repo and a local Chrome; see the script header).

Legends

Diagram type How to read it
Flowchart (01, 02, 03, 30, 40) Boxes are systems or parts; rounded boxes are people; cylinders are data stores. A solid arrow is a call or a flow; a dotted arrow is optional, later (R2) or asynchronous. Grey frames group things that run together.
State diagram (10 to 13) Each box is a status. An arrow is an allowed move, labelled with who or what causes it. The black dot is the start; the circled dot is the end. A move not drawn is forbidden.
Sequence diagram (20 to 24) Columns are actors (people) and participants (systems). Time goes down. Solid arrows are requests, dashed arrows are replies, open arrows are messages sent later by a worker. Numbered steps match the text. alt boxes show alternative paths.
ERD (erd-*) Each box is a table with its columns (type, name, and PK = primary key, FK = link, UK = unique). A line links a table to the one it points to; the label is the linking column. `

Architecture

File Caption
01-system-context Who uses BLADUS and which outside services it talks to. Guests and hosts use the website, staff use the admin app; both call one Django API. The payment gateway is dotted because online payment comes in release R2.
02-containers What runs where. Everything holding personal data runs in Algerian data centres (research C.3, to be confirmed by a lawyer). The Next.js servers keep the login cookie and call Django on the browser's behalf (BFF). Workers send messages and run timed jobs.
03-django-apps The backend is one application split into 17 apps plus a small core, arranged in layers. An app may only use apps in lower layers (checked automatically by import-linter); for example bookings may use pricing and the ledger, never the reverse. Events (emails, search refresh) go through the outbox instead of direct calls. Details in 07-architecture.md.
30-money-flow Where money goes. At launch (M1) the guest pays the host, the host keeps a deposit at BLADUS, and BLADUS takes its commission from that deposit. M4 (BLADUS collects and pays out) is drawn for later and needs a licence.
40-document-map How the blueprint documents feed each other, from inventory to tests.

Lifecycles (state machines)

File Caption
10-booking-states Every status a booking can have. A request waits up to 24 hours for the host; a confirmed booking becomes completed automatically after check-out. awaiting_payment stays unused until online payment exists. Rules BR-BKG-01 to 07.
11-listing-states A listing or trip is checked by staff before it is published (DEC-003). Hosts can pause; staff can suspend or ask for changes. Deleting is reversible by staff.
12-host-verification-states A host (person or organisation) is approved only when all required documents are approved. Changing legal details sends it back to review.
13-review-states A review is written after a completed stay, published when both sides wrote or after 14 days, and can be hidden after a report.

Key flows (sequences)

File Caption
20-seq-instant-booking An instant booking from price quote to confirmation in one database transaction; the database itself refuses overlapping dates; the commission is posted to the host's wallet; messages go out after the save.
21-seq-request-to-book A request: the host accepts, declines, or a timed job expires it after 24 hours. Dates stay blocked while it waits.
22-seq-wallet-topup A host tops up the commission deposit by transfer; finance records it with the receipt reference; large amounts need a second person.
23-seq-host-onboarding Becoming a host: the steps come from the published configuration, the draft is saved on the server, documents go to private storage, staff verify.
24-seq-message-sync Messages are fetched with a cursor so polling is cheap; phone numbers are masked until a booking is confirmed (anti-fraud).

Database (ERDs, generated)

File Caption
erd-00-overview The 26 central tables and their main links. Start here. host_account sits between people and organisations on one side and listings, trips and wallets on the other.
erd-01-accounts People, staff roles and permissions, consents, favourites.
erd-02-geography 69 wilayas, dairas and 1,541 communes.
erd-03-host-accounts-and-organisations Host accounts, organisations, team members, invitations, verification documents, payout accounts.
erd-04-taxonomy Shared lists: categories, property types, amenities, cancellation policies.
erd-05-catalogue-listings-and-room-types Listings, edits under review, vehicle and experience details, room types, photos, featured places.
erd-06-inventory-and-calendar What is free per day (homes, vehicles), per night and room type (hotels, hostels) and per time slot (experiences).
erd-07-trips-agency-only Agency trips, day-by-day itinerary, dated departures with seats.
erd-08-pricing Price quotes and tax rates.
erd-09-bookings Bookings, their status history, refunds owed, disputes.
erd-10-money-ledger-wallet-dormant-payments The ledger, balances, deposit top-ups, gateway webhooks, and the tables kept unused until the money model changes.
erd-11-reviews Reviews, replies, reports.
erd-12-messaging-and-notifications Conversations, messages, notifications, preferences, the outbox and delivery log.
erd-13-media Uploaded files (public photos, private documents).
erd-14-moderation-config-audit-privacy-system Staff queues and decisions, settings and onboarding versions, coupons, audit log, exports, privacy requests, idempotency, search table.

Check yourself

  • In the booking state diagram, which statuses are final?
  • In the instant booking sequence, at which step could a double booking be refused, and by what?
  • In an ERD, what does a box with only id mean?
  • Which diagram shows that personal data stays in Algeria?
